CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an explicit organization/access origin, and a separate status field (executed_branch_claim:false) are all present for the same referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content items with attributes (colour and coordinate sets).

D.rationale: A separate status field (executed_branch_claim:false) distinguishes a content identity from an execution/presentation status.

O.rationale: Origin/represented_time and inherited/current markers describe how and when contents are represented or accessed.
